items.title: Robotics and Human-Machine Interaction Technology Demonstration
description: Demonstrated dynamometer robotic systems, rehabilitation robots, wearable exoskeletons, and sensing technologies to engage and educate students, faculty members, and external visitors

Presented robotics, sensing systems, and human-machine interaction technologies to visiting professors, graduate researchers (visiting PhD, PhD, and Master students), senior undergraduate students, and first-year engineering students
Supported educational outreach activities for courses and projects related to dynamic systems, biosignal processing, rehabilitation robotics, and intelligent sensing systems
Facilitated technical demonstrations and discussions for external visitors, including members of the Society of Professional Engineers

items.title: FIRST Robotics Competition – University of Waterloo District Event
description: Interviewed robotics teams and evaluated engineering design, technical innovation, project execution, and teamwork performance
Assessed competition submissions and team presentations to support award selection and judging decisions
Contributed to promoting STEM education, collaborative engineering practices, and student innovation in robotics competitions

items.title: FIRST Robotics Competition – Pit Administration Operations
description: Supported robotics teams in the pit administration area by coordinating team check-in and operational logistics
Answered participant questions, coordinated event announcements, and facilitated communication between teams and event organizers
Helped ensure safety compliance and smooth operation of pit activities during the competition event

items.title: ExpecTAtion Workshop for Teaching Assistants
description: Mentored future teaching assistants during a two-day TA training workshop organized by the Systems Design Engineering Department
Provided guidance on effective tutorial delivery, assignment marking strategies, and general teaching assistant responsibilities
Supported trainee development in professional communication and interactions with course instructors and students

items.title: Corporate Table Tennis Tournament Officiating
description: Oversaw fair play and enforced tournament rules during men's and women's table tennis matches
Made officiating decisions regarding serves, scoring, and player conduct throughout tournament games
Recorded and submitted official match results to tournament organizers and event coordinators
